name: Atlantic Royal Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (minas gerais, rio de janeiro, são paulo, and paraná)
description: Endemic to southeastern Brazil. Uncommon, medium-sized, overall brown flycatcher of humid tropical forest in lowlands.

name: Harris's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Breeds north-central canada; winters to southern usa
description: Large sparrow that is largely restricted to the middle of North America. Breeds in boreal forest and shrubbery in the far north of central Canada, and winters in shrubby or weedy areas in the southern Great Plains.

name: Townsend's Warbler
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of western north america; winters to costa rica
description: Brightly-colored warbler with a contrasting face pattern with dark cheeks and crown surrounded by bright yellow. Also shows olive back, bold white wingbars, and yellow on the breast.

name: Unadorned Flycatcher
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern peru (cusco) to western bolivia
description: Dull, medium-sized flycatcher of montane forest. Greenish gray, with dull reddish wings that have weak reddish wing bars.

name: Baird's Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Arid southwestern ecuador to northwestern peru (lima)
description: Large, stout-billed flycatcher restricted to arid areas and oases of northwestern Peru and western Ecuador. Distinctive in range, with yellow belly, chestnut wings and tail, and black mask.

name: Abd al Kuri Sparrow
rangeDescription: Socotra (abd al kuri)
description: Typical “rufous sparrow”, with a striped back and a gray crown, nape, and rump. Males have a black bib, and are brighter overall, with more rufous on the face and shoulder.

name: Ruddy Duck
rangeDescription: Interior northwestern north america (southwestern canada to mexico); west indies
description: Small, compact duck with a long, fan-shaped tail, often held sticking up out of water. Breeding males have a chestnut body, black cap, white cheek, and baby-blue bill.

name: Cricket Longtail
rangeDescription: Mauritania and senegal to mali, central sudan, and northern ethiopia
description: Tiny warbler with an extremely long, strongly-patterned tail. Note blackish wing coverts with white tips, gray on the back of the neck, and a warm brown back.

name: Azure Gallinule
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southern venezuela, the guianas, northern argentina, and brazil
description: Small, pale chickenlike marsh bird with washed out gray-blue underparts that contrast with its olive brown back and crown. Note the thick yellow bill and frontal shield.

name: Ibadan Malimbe
rangeDescription: Savanna of southwestern nigeria
description: A striking black-and-red forest malimbe. Male has a black face and a red crown, nape, neck, and breast; female similar, with a narrower breast band.

name: Pileated Parrot
rangeDescription: Humid forest of southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Fairly small parrot usually seen in small groups or pairs in the canopy of humid forests, including Araucaria forests. The body is mostly green apart from a blue outer wing and tail feathers.

name: Golden-crested Myna
rangeDescription: Northeastern india to myanmar, thailand (including the northern thai-malay peninsula), and indochina
description: Unmistakable glossy black bird with a dash of bright yellow on the head and wings. Male has more extensive yellow on the head than the female.

name: Glaucous Tanager
rangeDescription: Arid northeastern colombia and northern venezuela including isla margarita
description: Medium-sized tanager with gray head and back, blue-gray chest, white belly, and aquamarine wings. Often seen singly or in pairs; usually less abundant than similar Blue-gray Tanager.

name: Swamp Harrier
rangeDescription: Breeds australia (except south-central), north, south, stewart, and chatham islands (east of south island; new zealand), vanuatu, new caledonia including loyalty islands, to fiji and tonga (southwestern and south-central polynesia); non-breeders range to trans-fly (south-central new guinea) and kermadec islands (northeast of north island, new zealand)
description: Long-legged medium-sized raptor with long narrow wings. Adult has varied plumage, but note diagnostic prominent white rump.

name: Oriental Darter
rangeDescription: India to southeastern asia, malay archipelago, and philippines
description: A waterbird with a very long, slender, snakelike neck and a long, pointed bill. Breeding adults have a shiny black body with silvery-white streaks along the wings, a brownish crown and neck, and a white stripe running from the eye to the side of the neck.

name: Least Pauraque
rangeDescription: Semiarid lowlands of hispaniola and gonâve island
description: A nocturnal inhabitant of open arid woodlands and thornscrub. Perches on ground from which it makes floppy and erratic flight upon its long wings in pursuit of insects.

name: Heard Island Shag
rangeDescription: Heard island (southern indian ocean)
description: Learn about Imperial Cormorant (Heard Island): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Mentawai Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Mentawai islands (off western sumatra)
description: This small, dark cinnamon-brown owl is the only resident scops-owl in its limited range. Inhabits a wide range of wooded habitats, from pristine lowland rainforest to plantations and woodlots around human habitation.

name: Seram White-eye
rangeDescription: Seram (southern moluccas)
description: A small green-backed songbird with a bold white eye-ring, a black face, a yellow throat, a white belly, and a yellow base to the undertail. Occurs in forest and nearby secondary growth in lowlands and foothills, sometimes in small groups.

name: Andaman Coucal
rangeDescription: Andaman islands and adjacent table, great and little coco islands
description: A large, pale-brown, ground-dwelling cuckoo with rusty wings and back. Skulks in bushes and low cover, where it moves clumsily as it searches for small invertebrates, small mammals, and birds to prey on.
